income-tax-return-filing.title: Basic KYC & Personal Details
items: Details of eligible bank account(s) for tax refund
Previous year's ITR and computation, if available

income-tax-return-filing.title: For Salaried Employees
items: Details of salary received from more than one employer, if applicable
Form 12BA or other salary-related documents, if applicable
Details of allowances, perquisites or other employment income, where applicable

income-tax-return-filing.title: Bank & Interest Income
items: Interest certificates from banks/post offices, where applicable

income-tax-return-filing.title: Tax Information & TDS
items: TDS certificates such as Form 16 / Form 16A, as applicable
Details of other taxes already paid

income-tax-return-filing.title: Investments & Deductions
income-tax-return-filing.after: The availability and amount of deductions depend on the applicable tax regime and Income Tax provisions.

income-tax-return-filing.title: House Property / Rental Income
income-tax-return-filing.intro: If you own or rent out property:
items: Co-owner details and ownership percentage, where applicable

income-tax-return-filing.title: Capital Gains: Shares & Mutual Funds
items: Capital gains statement from broker/investment platform
Purchase and sale details where not available in the capital gains statement
Other supporting investment records, where applicable

income-tax-return-filing.title: Sale of Property / Real Estate
items: TDS details/certificates related to the property transaction
Details of any eligible reinvestment/exemption claimed

income-tax-return-filing.title: For Self-Employed Professionals & Freelancers
items: Books/accounts or income-expense statement, where maintained/required
Details of assets and liabilities, where applicable

income-tax-return-filing.title: For Proprietors & Business Owners
income-tax-return-filing.intro: Depending on the nature of the business:
items: Loan statements and interest certificates, where relevant
Previous year's financial statements and ITR

income-tax-return-filing.title: For Partnership Firms / LLPs
items: Trial Balance and books of accounts, where applicable
Partner remuneration and interest details, where applicable
Previous year's ITR and financial statements
Other statutory or financial records relevant to the return

income-tax-return-filing.title: Other Income, If Applicable
income-tax-return-filing.intro: Please also provide details of income from:
items: Cryptocurrency/Virtual Digital Asset transactions, where applicable
income-tax-return-filing.after: Additional documents may be required depending on the nature of the income.
